lines.en: My hooves press out little dirt pits
I am a horse shaped from dirt
My four legs step in perfect order
The saddle place on my back is for a soldier
My mane is clods of dry soil
I shed crumbs when I run
I circle the battlefield once
My body is lighter than a real horse

lines.zh: 我踏过的草都变成了土色
lines.en: The grass I tread turns the color of earth

lines.zh: 我的蹄印在土路上很清楚
lines.en: My hoofprints are clear on the dirt road
I set each step level

lines.zh: 我从队列后面跑到前面
lines.en: I run from the back of the line to the front

lines.zh: 我拐弯时四条腿一起转
lines.en: All four legs turn together when I bend
My four hooves are set
My head stays pointed forward
I wait for a warrior to mount
I listen for a horn far off
My clay still holds some damp
My ears turned once
I wait at the edge of the shade

lines.zh: 我的鬃毛被风吹散了一点
lines.en: The wind has loosened my mane a little

lines.zh: 我把一条后腿稍微松开
lines.en: I ease one hind leg slightly
I count the soldiers passing
My saddle place is still empty
Are you going to ride me

lines.zh: 我的背上已经空了很久
lines.en: My back has been empty a long time
You are not made of clay
I know the hands that shaped me
Where do you want to take me
I am faster than a soldier on foot
I wait for you to mount
You are standing in front of my head
My hooves are bigger than your feet
To ride me, you would have to shape me first

lines.zh: 我不认得你身上的味道
lines.en: I do not know your scent

lines.zh: 我们不是一个材料做的
lines.en: We are not made of the same material
Move aside, I am about to run
I can carry only one rider
Several clods fell off me
My leg is a little crooked
I do not hurt, I am only less
I set my four legs firmly
These four legs can still run
A chunk fell from my flank
My legs can barely hold
My body is lighter than before
I fell back half a step to steady

lines.zh: 我掉下的土在地上堆了一小堆
lines.en: The clay I lost is a small heap on the ground
Grass is not my food
I am earth myself
What are you raising that for
This is not food to me
Leave it in the dirt; I still won't eat it.
My mouth is only a shape
I am waiting for you to mount
Clay needs no feeding
I will not take what you hold
You hit my leg

lines.zh: 我晃了一下，掉了几粒土
lines.en: I swayed and a few crumbs fell
My hooves sank into the soil

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，声音闷闷的
lines.en: We collided with a muffled sound
I give way one step
My clay body did not scatter
I set my four legs again

lines.zh: 你的膝盖撞到我的胸口
lines.en: Your knee hit my chest
My legs held

lines.zh: 我们相撞的时候我比你先站稳
lines.en: When we collided, I steadied first
I am a horse of clay
I have no need for such things
I only wait to be saddled
My kind never look at one another
I turn my head back
I have never thought of it
We were made to be used
I do not think about such things
My head always looks forward
Should this go on my back
I set it beside the saddle place
I can carry anything on the ground
I nudge it with my nose
This will not ride steady

lines.zh: 我蹄子上的泥，掉不下来
lines.en: The dirt on my hooves won't come off
I wait for a soldier to take it
I lower my head and push the bag over
I can carry this
Something is on my route
I lift my forehooves
I set myself toward that direction
My soldier is still waiting
I must charge through first
I have its position
I break into a run
I see the shape ahead
My forehooves start pawing the dirt
This distance suits a charge

lines.zh: 我朝它的方向压低了鬃毛
lines.en: I flatten my mane toward it
I swing out on an arc
My hoofbeats are rapid
I keep closing the distance
My clay body is getting warm
I lower my head
It is right in front of me
I circle to its flank
It cannot turn as fast as I can
Dust flies from under my hooves
I wait for the soldier's signal
I am three blocks off now
I strike with my forehooves
I shoulder its path open
This one carries all my clay
I turn back immediately after the charge

lines.zh: 我的蹄子磕出一声闷响
lines.en: My hoof lands with a dull thud
I raise my forehooves and bring them down
I knock it open with my body

lines.zh: 这一下只用了半程的力
lines.en: This used only half my charge
I charge past its side

lines.zh: 我被摆在地上，然后站起来
lines.en: I was set down, and then I stood up
I rise out of the dirt on four legs.
I was shaped in the form of a horse
My saddle place is empty
I can carry a soldier at a run
My hoofbeats are lighter than a real horse's

lines.zh: 土地里立起一匹马的形状
lines.en: A horse's shape rises out of the dirt

lines.zh: 我的四条腿一节节成型
lines.en: My four legs form joint by joint

lines.zh: 我的土色和这片地一样
lines.en: My earth color matches this ground
I shake out my mane
I am ready to be ridden

lines.zh: 我落地的时候压平了一小片草
lines.en: My landing flattened a patch of grass
I wait for someone to lead me away
My hooves have just hardened
I straighten from the waist up

lines.zh: 我踏出第一步就是战场的方向
lines.en: My first step is toward the battlefield
Fire hardened my clay

lines.zh: 我从坡上滚下来，摔散了
lines.en: I rolled down the slope and broke apart
Water softened my legs
The blast took half my body away
An arrow stuck in my back

lines.zh: 那股术力让我的土抖动
lines.en: That magic made my clay quiver
I am clay, I need no food
Lightning baked me into a hard lump
There is no ground under my hooves
